description: This file contains acceptance tests for the Company module in a SuiteCRM/SugarCRM extension, implemented using the Codeception testing framework. It defines the 'CompanyModuleCest' class with multiple test scenarios for creating, viewing, editing, duplicating, and deleting company records, utilizing various helper step classes for UI interactions.
